label: Giovanni degli Specchi
summary: German craftsman in Rome, subject of Leonardo's draft complaints to his patron in 1514 to 1515.

value.text: Draft letters of complaint, c.1514 to 1515

claims.statement: Leonardo's drafts (Codex Atlanticus) complain that 'Giovanni degli Specchi' obstructed his work and spied on his anatomical studies. Not confirmed in this round.

sources.cite: Standard literature. Model recall, not checked in this session.

open_questions: Dates and identity of Giovanni degli Specchi are not known; a separate 'Giorgio tedesco' is also named in the drafts.
